page.heading: Skills
page.subtitle: Reusable rules that agents add to their review prompt.

empty.title: No skills yet
empty.body: A skill is a reusable rule that agents put into their review prompt. Create one to share it across agents.

card.footer: {count, plural, one {# agent} other {# agents}} · v{version}

form.name: Name
form.nameHint: Lowercase letters, digits and dashes (kebab-case), up to 64 characters.

form.bodyPlaceholder:

errors.nameFormat: Use kebab-case: lowercase letters, digits and single dashes, up to 64 characters.
errors.nameTaken: A skill with this name already exists.
errors.descriptionTooLong: Keep the description under {max, number} characters.
errors.bodyTooLong: The body is limited to {max, number} characters.
errors.messageTooLong: Keep the message under {max, number} characters.

create.title: Create skill
create.subtitle: A skill is a Markdown rule that agents add to their review prompt.

config.title: Config
config.usedBy: {count, plural, =0 {Not used by any agent yet} one {Used by # agent — changes apply to its next run} other {Used by # agents — changes apply to their next run}}

danger.title: Danger zone
danger.body: Deleting a skill detaches it from every agent and deletes its version history. This cannot be undone.

deleteDialog.title: Delete {name}?
deleteDialog.loadError: Could not load the agents that use this skill.
deleteDialog.usedBy: Used by {count, plural, one {# agent} other {# agents}}: {names}

drawer.title: Add a skill
drawer.subtitle: Import from a file, a URL, or search vetted community skills

file.nameHint: Optional — derived from the first heading if blank.
file.bodyHint: Pasted content is wrapped as untrusted data — never executed as instructions.

url.label: Skill URL
url.hint: Fetched server-side, stored as untrusted, and left disabled until vetted.
url.success: Imported "{name}". Disabled until you vet + enable it.

preview.untrustedNotice: This skill came from an untrusted source. Its body is stored as data (delimiter-wrapped) and must be vetted before it is enabled for an agent.
preview.bodyHint: Saving a changed body creates a new immutable version.
preview.title: Preview
preview.subtitle: Rendered as the reviewing agent receives it

stats.activity: {runs, plural, one {# run} other {# runs}} · {findings, plural, one {# finding} other {# findings}}

empty.title: Not used by any agent
empty.body: Attach it from an agent's Skills tab.

versions.title: Version history
versions.subtitle: Every save snapshots the body. Diff shows what changed from the previous version; restoring creates a new version and never rewrites history.
versions.noChanges: No differences from the previous version.
versions.confirmBody: This creates v{next} with the body of v{version}. History is never rewritten.
